THE
GROUNDS
— built, not bought.

A training ground, not a gym chain. ATG was built in Tinwald for people who want to get genuinely strong — and to belong somewhere while they do it.

EST.
2024Tinwald

Ashburton Training Grounds is a martial arts and strength gym in Tinwald, Ashburton — a big open floor, heavy bags, racks and plates, and coaches who actually watch you train.

Here you don’t wander a crowded gym floor wondering what to do next. You turn up, you’re coached, you work hard alongside people who know your name — and you leave stronger than you arrived.

  • Strength, conditioning & martial arts under one roof
  • Coached classes for adults, mums and kids
  • A family feel — the ATG family trains together
  • Personal training for one-to-one coaching

TRAIN
THE WEEK
— find your class.

From first-timers to fighters, there’s a session for you. Class times run on the gym’s timetable — email us and we’ll send you the current week.

01

Spartan Class — conditioning

High-energy conditioning that builds engine, grit and work capacity. Hard work, done together — the session the ATG family is known for.

Adults

Technical Striking — Muay Thai skills

Learn to strike properly: pads, bags and technique, coached step by step. Open training and technical striking for all levels.

Technical Sparring — put it together

Controlled sparring for members ready to test their skills safely, under the coaches’ eye.

Mums & Bubs — strength & circuit

Little Spartans — kids’ classes

Personal Training — one to one

WHY ATG
BEATS THE
big-box gym.

Ashburton has plenty of places to swipe a key tag and train alone. ATG is the opposite — and that’s the point.

The big-box gym

Alone on the floor

  • Key-tag access — nobody knows your name
  • Busy after work — wait for the rack
  • Classes on a screen, no coach watching you
  • Built for everyone, made for no one
Ashburton Training Grounds

Coached. Known. Pushed.

  • Coached sessions — every class, every week
  • A real community — the ATG family trains together
  • Strength + martial arts — not just machines in a row
  • All ages, all levels — mums, kids and fighters alike
